words.gloss: there also (in the other world too)

literal: Desirelessness like supreme wealth here is not; there also that equal is not.
translation: There is no supreme wealth in this world like desirelessness; even in the other world, there is nothing equal to it.
modern: ஆசையின்மை போன்ற சிறந்த செல்வம் இவ்வுலகில் இல்லை; அவ்வுலகிலும் அதற்கு இணையானது எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of desirelessness (வேண்டாமை), describing it as the greatest possible wealth. The author asserts that in this earthly life (ஈண்டு), there is no treasure that compares to being free from desires. Furthermore, even in the other world or any higher state of existence (ஆண்டு), there is absolutely nothing that can equal the profound peace and richness of having no wants.
